questions.question:
Two Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some Parrots are Birds.

All Birds are animals.

**Conclusions:**

I. All animals are Birds.

II. Some animals are Parrot.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
Given Statements:

Some Parrots are Birds.

All Birds are animals.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/828c882548c759acb98747eeb21633e8bd59b8c330f179674590e8f5d538a7cd.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All animals are Birds - False (Because, All birds are animals gives some animals are definitely birds, but All animals are birds can be possible only).

II. Some animals are Parrot - True (Because, those part of parrots which is birds will animals also).

So, Only conclusion II follows. 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question: Seven students A, B, C, D, X, Y and Z are sitting in their classroom facing in the southern direction. A and D do not sit together. Z sits second to the left of X. B does not sit with Z. X is fourth to the right of C. A and B are not sitting together. C sits in between D and Y. Y sits second to the left of the one who sits second to the left of B. Who sits at the extreme ends?
questions.solution:
Given: Seven students A, B, C, D, X, Y and Z are sitting in their classroom facing in the southern direction.

1) Z sits second to the left of X.

2) X is fourth to the right of C.

3) C sits in between D and Y.

4) Y sits second to the left of the one who sits second to the left of B.

5) B does not sit with Z and A and B are not sitting together.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8fe4552da1eb9ae4c689db97371550582814c72defec849bba7659cb68582349.png] 

A and D do not sit together.

And, A will sit at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b6e138f7e36069a3381b1ed87a47cda2c8c33a0bb36e87ea1da2c257dc51a35.png] 

Here, '**B and D**' sits at the extreme ends.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.

questions.question:
If A denotes 'addition’, B denotes 'multiplication', C denotes ‘subtraction’, and D denotes 'division’, then what will be the value of the following equation?

10 B 2 C (15 D 5) = ?
questions.solution:
Given equation: 10 B 2 C (15 D 5) = ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information :

 
 

 Symbol
 A
 B
 C
 D
 
 

 Means
 +
 ×
 -
 ÷
 
 

Now, replacing the sign from left to right and using BODMAS rule, we get :

New equation : 10 × 2 - (15 ÷ 5) = ?

Calculation :

⇒ 10 × 2 - (__**15 **____**÷**____** 5**__) = ?

⇒ __**10 × 2**__ - 3 = ?

⇒ __20 ____- 3__ = **17**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

Bangladesh : Dhaka :: New Zealand : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: The second word represents the **capital **of the respective **country**.

Bangladesh : Dhaka → Dhaka is the **capital **city of Bangladesh.

Similarly:

New Zealand : Wellington → Wellington is the **capital **city of New Zealand.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets. (NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

(4, 3, 49)

(5, 4, 81)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number + 2nd number)² = 3rd number.

Now,

For, (4, 3, 49)

⇒ (4 + 3)²

⇒ 7² = 49.

For, (5, 4, 81) 

⇒ (5 + 4)2

⇒ 92 = 81.

Similarly, for **(6, 5, 121)**

**⇒ (6 + 5)2**

**⇒ 112 = 121.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
